messages:
alex: RFC draft — propose quota bands + burst shaping for free / pro / enterprise. Goal: predictable unit economics, graceful UX for short spikes. want quick sync on enforcement point and console UX.

maya: +1. main callouts: per-org monthly quota, per-key short-term burst token bucket, and a throttling strategy (soft-limit warnings then hard 429). how do we map to pricing tiers?

samir: agree. metrics we need before rolling: token_rate_per_min, burst_consumed, consecutive_429_count, route_latency. also need per-route weights (embedding vs text gen).

jordan: rough config proposal (for discussion):
```
quota_config:
  free:
    monthly_tokens: 1_000_000
    base_rps: 5
    burst_bucket: 2_500
  pro:
    monthly_tokens: 50_000_000
    base_rps: 50
    burst_bucket: 25_000
  enterprise:
    monthly_tokens: unlimited
    base_rps: 200
    burst_bucket: 200_000
    burst_policy: negotiated
```
pros: simple, predictable. cons: free bursts can be gamed unless we add decay or abuse heuristics.

maya: for free we should cap burst window to 1 minute decay and require captcha/check on signup for large consumers. also show console banner when near monthly cap.

alex: enforcement point question — do we do shaping at edge (api-gateway) or at serving runtime? my preference: gate at edge for rps/burst, then downstream quota-meter for monthly tokens for accounting. that keeps tail latencies consistent.

samir: +1 to edge shaping. implementation note: token-bucket in API gateway with per-key and per-org keys. fallback path: when burst exhausted, instead of immediate 429 we can route to a lower-cost model variant (cheaper quantized) for non-enterprise customers. that preserves availability.

maya: love the fallback idea but we need product guardrails — we must surface clearly in console which calls used fallbacks and provide opt-out. telemetry: a "fallback_rate" metric per route per key.

jordan: UI mock: Console > Quotas page: show monthly usage, burst remaining (tokens), recent fallbacks, and a histogram of burst events. allow admins to tune enforcement (strict, lenient) and emergency top-up.

billing-bot: note: when plan transitions (free->pro), webhook will grant new entitlement bands. we need to ensure atomicity: grant tokens before removing previous bucket to avoid transient 429s.

deploy-bot: deploy started for quota-proxy v1.2.3 — will enable per-key bucket feature behind feature-flag "per_key_burst_v1".

alex: next steps: 1) samir + eng-infra to design edge token-bucket APIs and metrics (due EOW). 2) jordan + devex to mock console panels (3 working days). 3) maya + billing to define abuse heuristics and signup checks. 4) product to sign off on fallback policy wording. I'll sync with legal on enterprise negotiated bursts.

maya: tagging @samir @jordan for visibility, thanks. :thumbsup:

samir: will post a short PR with proto for the bucket API and metrics names.

alex: great. if no objections by EOD tomorrow we'll flip the feature-flag in staging and run a canary traffic test.
